name: Capybrute
look: a huge hunched brown capybara-marmot with an arched boulder-like back, orange slash markings, a small low head with a tan muzzle, scowling brow and big buck teeth, tan clawed forelegs and dark hind legs
entry: It lounges by rivers as calmly as a boulder and lets other Pokémon nap on its back, but it digs burrows through solid rock with those claws. Rile it and it charges with its head down, shrugging off blows that would flatten a house.
how: Wild: uncommon by rivers, in swamps and savannas, and in hills, mountains and highlands.
